messages.content: what's openclipper?

OpenClipper is a universal, cross-platform clipboard manager designed to eliminate the one-item limitation of traditional clipboards. Instead of replacing your previous copy, it captures multiple entries and assigns each a unique number. This allows you to collect multiple items (text, code, links) and instantly retrieve any of them using simple keyboard shortcuts like Ctrl+Shift+1 or Cmd+Shift+1 across Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android. The goal is to make information transfer seamless and effortless by removing the need to constantly switch windows or revisit original sources. Junaid intends to combine the best features of existing tools with a focus on speed, simplicity, and cross-platform consistency.

what about layer

Layer is an open-source tool designed to bridge the gap between AI coding agents and large-scale codebases. It serves as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides AI agents with symbol outlines, exact function slices, and impact graphs instead of raw file dumps.

It solves the issues of excessive token usage, hallucinated APIs, and broken refactors by using Tree-sitter for instant syntax checking and plugging into real toolchains (like tsc or cargo) for verified diagnostic feedback.

Tech Stack: Rust.
GitHub: https://github.com/junaidmirr/layer

It features constant-time symbol lookups, atomic indexing to prevent lock contention, and task-aware context ranking to optimize agent performance.
